[Image: A shaded equilateral triangle]

How many triangular tiles like this are needed to cover the figure below?

[Image: A seven-sided polygon]

Answer: ____

Figure, described in words:
At the top of the item is a solid black equilateral triangle with a horizontal base and its apex pointing directly upward. Below the question is an outline of a concave seven-sided polygon (heptagon) composed of five contiguous equilateral triangles of the same size as the tile above. The polygon has a horizontal bottom edge. From each end of the bottom edge, a side edge angles upward and outward at 60 degrees. From these two outer vertices, two edges angle upward and inward at 60 degrees to form two top peaks. From each top peak, an edge angles downward at 60 degrees toward the center, meeting in an interior V-shaped notch located at the center of what would otherwise be a regular hexagon.
